title: Auth token — JWT decoded without verifying the signature
message:
`jwt.decode()` (vs. `verify`), or `verify_signature: False` / `verify=False`, reads the claims WITHOUT checking the signature — the token is attacker-authored. Only ever decode-without-verify a token you already verified.

Evidence: `const claims = jwt.decode((req.headers.authorization || '').replace('Bearer ', ''));`
